children: Jazz Pharmaceuticals completed the $820 million acquisition of Actio Biosciences, gaining ABS-1230, a clinical-stage KCNT1-related epilepsy therapy candidate.
Acquisition finalized for $820 million upfront; Actio is now a wholly-owned subsidiary of Jazz Pharmaceuticals.
Deal adds ABS-1230, an oral, selective KCNT1 inhibitor with preclinical activity across pathogenic mutations.
Early clinical proof-of-concept showed meaningful seizure reductions in children with KCNT1-related epilepsy.
ABS-1230 holds Fast Track, Rare Pediatric Disease and Orphan Drug designations and is in FDA’s Rare Disease Evidence Principles process.
Non-ABS-1230 programs spun into a new private company; Jazz retains a minority stake and related rights.
